name: Selman Marrakech
positioning: Arab-Moorish palace hotel by Jacques Garcia at the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech, built around Arabian horses and a Chenot Spa
best_for: Horse lovers who want private stables and equestrian experiences on site
Travelers seeking a Chenot Spa wellness retreat in Marrakech
Guests wanting large suites or private villas set in gardens

facts.text: Selman Marrakech is a palace at the foot of the Atlas Mountains in Marrakech.
The Arab-Moorish inspired palace bears the signature of French architect and designer Jacques Garcia.
The hotel was conceived as a homage to the purebred Arabian horse.
Private villas sit within the hotel's gardens, with Arab-Moorish design by Jacques Garcia.
The villas span 580 to 700 square meters.
Each suite has a bedroom, a living room and one or two terraces overlooking the pool and Andalusian gardens.
The Suites and Suites Premier span 120 square meters and combine Jacques Garcia's style with Moroccan interiors.
Deluxe Premier Rooms are 55 square meters with views of the pool and the Andalusian gardens, detailed by Jacques Garcia.
The Chenot Spa covers 1,200 square meters and recalls the heated baths of old Istanbul.
The spa has seven treatment rooms, four hydrotherapy rooms, a hydro-massage pool, two heated outdoor pools, two hammams, a gym and a boutique.
The Chenot Spa offers 3, 5 or 10-day retreats, including the Chenot Relax Programme.
Assyl serves Moroccan cuisine prepared by an exclusively female brigade.

highlights.text: Guests can explore the hotel's private stables, where Selman Arabians are bred.
Signature experiences include a dinner in the stables, basics of dressage and working in liberty with the horses.
The hotel is one of six palaces in the world with a Chenot Spa.
Le Pavillon's Sunday brunch includes a parade of the hotel's Arabian horses.

considerations.text: Golf courses and trekking in the Atlas Mountains are nearby rather than on site.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside the central Marrakech medina area.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
